name: control-tower
description: Universal Chief-of-Staff coordinator for Google Antigravity: hidden-surface-first multi-agent dispatch (Swarm / Subagent / Workflow), zero-token Sentinel & Focus Gate inbox, single-slot resource leases, 3-tier Roadmap DAG, and a native Antigravity real-time SSE Aux Pane.
author: Hi-Jiajun
suggestedPrompts: 启用 control-tower 总控规程，对当前工作区执行纯只读冷启动盘点，并初始化或核对 SESSION-REGISTRY.md。
按 control-tower 隐藏面优先规范评估新需求：调用 ask_question 推荐最优执行面（原生 swarm / invoke_subagent / run_workflow / 白名单直派）与舒适区模型配比。
核查当前工作区后台优先级信箱、活跃执行面与路线图就绪分支，汇总阶段进展或生成总控换届交接卡。
